business_problem: Telefónica needed to produce far more localized and personalized marketing assets across regions and dialects, but manual content production was too slow and expensive to support high-volume campaigns efficiently.
solution_summary: Telefónica and Accenture built the Content Automation Tool, or CAT, as a multi-part platform for generating and optimizing marketing content at scale. CAT is integrated with Telefónica's marketing ecosystem and lets nontechnical users create brand-compliant assets from unified templates, while an automated dashboard supports reporting and management of micro-segmented campaigns. The platform applies generative AI and predictive heat-map capabilities to generate variations, estimate creative performance, and optimize messages using analytics from live campaigns. Its channel-agnostic design lets teams produce assets across multiple digital and physical formats through one interface, including outdoor digital screens and other media placements. By automating variant production and tying creation more closely to customer data and campaign performance, CAT shortens the cycle from concept to launch and gives Telefónica a reusable engine for hyper-personalized marketing.

solution_components.role: Estimate creative performance so Telefónica can optimize content before and during campaigns.

solution_components.name: automated dashboard

solution_components.name: gen AI capabilities
solution_components.role: Generate and optimize content variations based on campaign data and performance analytics.

data_flow: Marketing teams feed campaign templates and customer-segmentation needs into CAT, which uses generative AI and predictive heat-map capabilities to produce and optimize localized content variations. Performance data then flows into the automated dashboard so teams can refine messages, generate additional variants, and distribute assets across digital and physical channels through the same platform.
business_outcome: Telefónica increased content-production speed and scale, cut campaign cost and hours, improved clickthrough performance, and gained a reusable platform for hyper-personalized marketing across channels and regions.
